name: Stolen Destiny
source:
Clara (renamable!) is a fresh college grad that landed her first job at a museum, her dream job! 
She's wanted to work here since she was a little girl, especially in the Winston gallery, 
where precious stones and gems are featured! The main attraction is the famous Joy Diamond, 
but Clara's favorite has always been the Silver Kiss necklace. 
Tucked away in the back of the gallery, it doesn't usually get much love. 
One day she meets a handsome tourist and sly museum guard that also 
take interest in the necklace. That night she gets caught up in a robbery?! 
The Target? The Silver Kiss necklace, an unexpected target compared to the worth of the diamond. 

Why is there so much attention around this necklace? 
Who are these people that Clara just met? 
And what will happen to her when she's also taken?!

[from [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=39261]LemmaSoft Forums[/url]]
translation:
克拉拉（可重命名！）是一名应届大学毕业生，她在博物馆找到了第一份工作，这是她梦想的工作！
她从小就想在这里工作，尤其是在温斯顿画廊，
那里盛产宝石和宝石！主要景点是著名的Joy Diamond，
但克拉拉最喜欢的一直是银之吻项链。
它藏在画廊的后面，通常不会受到太多人的喜爱。
有一天，她遇到了一位英俊的游客和狡猾的博物馆警卫，他也 
对项链感兴趣。当晚她就遭遇了抢劫？！
目标？与钻石的价值相比，Silver Kiss项链是一个意想不到的目标。

为什么这条项链受到如此多的关注？
克拉拉刚刚遇到的这些人是谁？
当她也被带走时，她会发生什么？
